name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.3 (released 2026-04-30) is the latest stable release, fixing native module loading in signed macOS DMG builds. The landmark v0.4.0 release (433 commits since v0.3.4) introduced a multi-provider AI runtime supporting 8 CLI providers (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.), an installable Skills system, terminal mode with PTY adapters, a rebuilt Tasks Board v2 with drag-and-drop, and a full Cmd+K search palette. The project also added MIT licensing, anonymous opt-out telemetry, and numerous UX/accessibility improvements. See release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in April 2026, including several patch releases on 2026-04-30
answers.Does it support user authentication?: No explicit user authentication system mentioned; legal/ToS acceptance flow present but no login/auth described
answers.Is there a Docker image available?: No — distribution is via macOS DMG and npm CLI (cabinetai)

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more advanced document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to set up than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and versioning, but requires more resources and configuration compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted cloud platform covering files and much more, but is overkill if you only need a simple document cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document organization with OCR and metadata extraction, but has a steeper learning curve and heavier stack than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Mayan EDMS
alternatives.review: Mayan EDMS is an enterprise-grade document management system with extensive features, making it far more powerful but considerably more complex than the lightweight Cabinet project.
